checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man
must.why: Same face, hair, stubble, grey tee and kitchen across all frames.

must.item: Audible coherent agent-written English line inviting viewers to the sale
must.why: Audio has sound with peak -0.5 dB, but the speech was not transcribed; the written line is fine.

must.item: No invented discount, date, product or offer
must.why: The scripted line is generic, but the spoken audio could not be verified.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: Mouth is open and in different shapes across frames, which suggests speech. Exact sync cannot be verified from stills.

must.item: One square 8s video, friendly male voice, no captions
must.why: Frames are square, with no captions. Length is 8 s and there is audio. Voice gender and tone cannot be verified, so this is judged from the stated specs.

faults.what: The face looks a bit more animated and wrinkled than in the original photo, with a broader grin in the first frame and slightly different framing. The likeness is still good.

summary: The clip shows the same grey-haired man speaking warmly in his kitchen with no captions and a natural look; the audio content could not be verified.
